title: NEW MSFS 2024 Marketplace Activity Packs! Perfect Flight United 787 & Iberia A320 Breakdown
description:
The weekly Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace update is here, and this time we are diving deep into a massive wave of new activities from Perfect Flight built to take your airliner pilot career to the next level in MSFS 2024.

Early community feedback is pouring in for these commercial airliner expansions, stirring up talk across the virtual flight community. Whether you want to command longhaul heavy metal across North America or work through a multi European summer schedule in a narrowbody jet, these releases deliver a structured excuse to jump back into the left seat. To help you decide if they are worth adding to your virtual hangar, we are breaking down everything included in these new additions:

First up, we are analyzing the special edition heavy operations featuring the "America 250" United Airlines Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner pack. Celebrating the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, this pack includes 12 monitored IFR missions, 100+ distinct flight events, and authentic aviation sounds across multiple city pairings. (Note: Requires the MSFS Premium Deluxe edition for the 787-10 model).

Next, group two throws you directly into European scheduled network rotations with the "12 Legs Iberia Summer 2026" schedule. Designed for the Airbus A320neo Version 2, this addon lets you pilot 12 distinct IFR sectors across Europe's busiest routes, complete with custom audio, interactive flight tracking, and full compatibility with third-party scenery.

✈️ What do you think? Are you planning to pick up the patriotic United 787 longhaul pack, or are you going to stick to the European Iberia narrowbody rotations? Let me know your thoughts in the comment section below!

Don't forget to like, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
